rows.label: H4-search

rule: H4-01..H4-04 and H4-search stay NOT_VERIFIED until real B20a-exec/B20a-search artifacts exist and A/C sign their own scope. B20b records the gap; it does not promote a constructed negative, a known-candidate chain or an execution fact into positive evidence.
